rationale: Acetate is abundant and my preferred carbon source. Ammonium and amino acids provide nitrogen (limiting nutrient). Growth at 0.25 /h balances carbon and nitrogen availability. Fermentation yields CO₂, formate, and minor H₂ as waste products. Carbon audit: 13.5 mmol C in; 10.5 (growth) + 3.0 (fermentation) = 13.5 out. Nitrogen: 3.0 mmol N in; 0.25 × 10 = 2.5 for growth, 0.5 margin.
